_comment: EXAMPLE ONLY. Generate your own with: node scripts/make-league-config.js <espnLeagueId> - it reads your league's real scoring and roster settings out of ESPN so you do not have to hand-write any of this.
name: Example League
myTeamName: Your Team Name Exactly As It Appears In ESPN

draftedCounts._comment: How many at each position actually come off the board across the whole draft. Feeds replacement level. Measure it with scripts/sweep.js once you have a board, or leave these defaults.

scoring._comment: Generated from ESPN scoringSettings.scoringItems. `all` applies to every position; `dst` is the D/ST override map (ESPN pointsOverrides keyed by position 16).

tuning._comment: ESPN ADP for IDP comes from deep-IDP leagues and is meaningless in a 1-DP league; force late.

opponentModel._comment: OFF for the 2026 draft. The idea is sound - during a live draft we know every opponent's real roster, which market ADP cannot see - but it could not be shown to help. Paired A/B over 36 drafts: full version -3.20 (t=-1.78, 6 better/14 worse); restricted to market-blind players only -2.06 (t=-1.41, 1 better/5 worse/30 tie). The sweep IS biased toward the market curve because its bots draft from ADP, so these numbers overstate the harm - but no test showed a gain, and an unvalidated model does not belong on the critical path hours before a real draft. The first version was also badly miscalibrated (it put a 1.7-stdev player at 35% to survive 9 picks against a true ~0-2%); that is fixed, and flat need now reproduces the market curve exactly, so this can be switched on later and re-measured honestly. The 'next N teams need' display is NOT gated on this - it reads live rosters directly and stays on.

draftRules._comment: Guardrails: earliestRound stops the model taking a position too early; runThresholds define how many of a position in the last 12 picks counts as a run. Both should be re-measured for YOUR league - see scripts/rail-ab.js and the README section on measuring changes.

byeWeights._comment: Bye collisions are only priced once the bench cannot absorb them. Measured: a 3-starter bye week cost 20 pts vs a 151-pt clean week. freeCover is how many shared byes the bench covers for free.

draftRules._qbNote: Two seasons of this league re-scored: QB draft slot only weakly predicts outcome. 2024 declined monotonically with draft position (586 -> 526 -> 502 -> 406 by pick band) but 2025 INVERTED (415 -> 447 -> 553 -> 504). Every startable QB landed 400-750 in both years. So do not pay a premium and do not punt to R15 either; the middle rounds are right, which is where the model already lands.

runThresholds._comment: A run should mean UNUSUAL concentration, not the normal rate. Measured over 181 rolling 12-pick windows of the consensus order: '3+ WR in the last 12' is true in 87% of windows, '3+ RB' in 52%. The old flat threshold of 3 therefore fired almost constantly at WR - printing '3-deep WR run happening' on most picks and quietly handing WRs a +6 score boost as a near-permanent bias. These per-position thresholds each fire in roughly 15-20% of windows, which is what makes the signal worth reading on a 30-second clock.
